ValidationRule.description: Start Date, Project Duration, Amount, ATG RFR and Service Delivery Model are all required at Proposal Stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Proposal/Price Quote"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Negotiation/Review"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Verbal/Commit"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Verbal/Billable"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Won") ), ISBLANK( Start_Date__c)|| ISBLANK(TEXT( Service_Delivery_Model__c))|| ISBLANK ( ATG_RFR__c )|| ISBLANK( Project_Duration__c)|| ISBLANK( Amount ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Start Date, Project Duration, Amount, Gross Margin Percent, Service Delivery Model, and ATG RFR are required fields at Proposal stage
